description: Patched with newRetiled, credit to migbrunluz. You won't get a YouTube experience like this anywhere else. Enjoy your favorite content to the fullest in this beautifully animated, feature packed YouTube client. Watch while you work in other apps with picture-in-picture or background audio, clip videos into short GIFs or MP4s to share with your friends, get a heads up on the latest videos from your favorite channels with live tiles and notifications, and much more!
